nodes.label: ShadowCube.vert (cube shadow capture vertex shader)
nodes.rationale: Run six times per shadow-casting torch per frame, once per cube face; projects with the face's view-projection matrix and forwards the vertex's world position to the fragment stage.

nodes.label: Push constants freeze at command-buffer record time
nodes.rationale: The command buffer is recorded once per swapchain image and reused, so a push constant's value never re-evaluates; that is why the cube pass moved lightViewProj and lightPos into a uniform buffer, whose contents are read fresh at draw time.

nodes.label: Face index as the one surviving push constant
nodes.rationale: Which of the six faces a draw is for is a fixed property of where in the recorded loop the draw sits, so unlike the matrices it is genuinely constant and stays a push constant.
